name: ESSAI 2026
venue: European Summer School on Artificial Intelligence, Vienna, Austria
description: The 4th European Summer School on Artificial Intelligence (ESSAI) takes place in Vienna, Austria, from 6 to 10 July 2026. It offers a one‑week program of introductory and advanced AI courses, specialized tutorials on Bilateral AI and Digital Humanism, and opportunities to learn from leading experts. The school also provides networking events and social activities, fostering collaboration among PhD students, young researchers, and senior scholars.

name: OpenEuroLLM Winter School
venue: Skeikampen Conference Hotel, near Oslo, Norway
description: The 2026 Winter School on Multilinguality in LLM Development and Evaluation is organized by the Nordic Language Processing Laboratory and the University of Oslo and takes place at the Skeikampen conference hotel north of Oslo, Norway. It targets NLP researchers, especially those from EuroHPC consortium countries and doctoral students, and focuses on multilingual large language models, their evaluation, data curation, and dialectal challenges. The program combines technical talks, hands‑on sessions, and field activities such as a ski‑friendly location and bus transfers, and participation is subsidized by the OpenEuroLLM project.

name: Probabilistic AI School
description: The ProbAI School 2026 is a Probabilistic AI School taking place in Vilnius, Lithuania. It aims to provide an inclusive educational environment covering state‑of‑the‑art machine learning and artificial intelligence topics for enthusiasts, students, academics and industry professionals. The event is co‑organized with the Artificial Intelligence Association of Lithuania (AIAL).

name: BMVA Computer Vision Summer School
description: The 29th BMVA Computer Vision Summer School will be held at Durham University in Durham, England, UK. It offers an intensive week of lectures and lab sessions covering a wide range of computer‑vision topics, delivered by researchers from leading UK and international groups. The programme is designed for students and early‑career researchers seeking hands‑on experience and exposure to current advances in the field.

name: Oxford Machine Learning Summer School 2026
venue: Oxford Machine Learning School, Oxford, United Kingdom
description: OxML 2026 was the Oxford Machine Learning School, bringing together three advanced machine‑learning programmes in online and hybrid formats. The programmes covered practical AI model building (MLx Cases), applications in health and biomedical sciences (MLx Health & Bio), and the latest advances in representation learning and generative AI (MLx Representation Learning & Gen AI). The school targeted researchers and practitioners seeking hands‑on experience with cutting‑edge models and was delivered by leading experts from Oxford and partner institutions.

name: Robotics, Perception and Learning (RPL) Summer School
venue: KTH Royal Institute of Technology, Stockholm, Sweden
description: The RPL Summer School 2026 is a six‑day event for doctoral and postdoctoral researchers organized by the Department for Robotics, Perception and Learning at KTH Royal Institute of Technology in Stockholm, Sweden. It covers a broad spectrum of topics in robotics, perception and learning, including machine learning, computer vision, human‑robot interaction, planning and decision making, and combines keynote talks, industry panels, and brainstorming sessions. The school is held at the Happy Tammsvik resort where participants receive free accommodation, meals and activities, fostering collaboration and the generation of concrete research ideas.

name: Machine Learning Crash Course at MALGA
description: The MLCC2026 Summer School – Machine Learning Crash Course – provides an introduction to fundamental machine‑learning concepts and algorithms. It is aimed at undergraduate and graduate students, as well as professionals, and is open to participants from any university after a selection process. The five‑day in‑person program in Genoa combines theoretical lectures with hands‑on lab sessions and includes a final test consisting of notebook work and a report.

name: UK Robotics Summer School
venue: National Robotarium, Heriot-Watt University, Edinburgh, United Kingdom
description: The UK Robotics Summer School is a five‑day event held at the National Robotarium, Heriot‑Watt University in Edinburgh, Scotland. It offers expert‑led lectures, tutorials, industry talks and hands‑on experience with state‑of‑the‑art robotics technology, focusing on cutting‑edge topics in the field. The programme is aimed at master’s‑level students and industry practitioners, providing networking opportunities with academics and industry leaders.

name: International Summer School for Advanced Studies on Biometrics, Behavior, and Vision
venue: Hotel Dei Pini, Porto Conte, Alghero, Sardinia, Italy
description: The 2027 Biometrics International Summer School takes place at Hotel Dei Pini in Porto Conte, near Alghero, Sardinia, Italy. It focuses on the impact of agentic AI and vision foundation models on biometrics and human recognition, covering topics such as machine learning, image understanding, signal analysis, neuroscience, robotics, and digital forensics. The program is aimed at PhD students, post‑docs, researchers, forensic examiners and professionals, offering intensive lectures, keynote talks, and hands‑on sessions with opportunities for scholarships and networking.

name: Winter School on Ethical, Legal, and Societal (ELS) aspects of AI and AS at Umeå University
description: The Winter School on Ethical, Legal, and Societal (ELS) aspects of AI and AS focuses on the societal implications of artificial intelligence and autonomous systems. It brings together researchers, policymakers, and practitioners to discuss ethical frameworks, legal regulations, and broader societal impacts. Materials and project repositories for the school are hosted on GitHub and the site is generated with GitHub Pages using Merlot.

name: Winter School on Social Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Multimedia (SoRAIM 2026)
description: The ACM Europe Winter School SoRAIM’27 focuses on social robotics, artificial intelligence, and multimedia. It targets PhD students and early‑career researchers, offering lectures, hands‑on sessions, and informal networking in a mountain setting near Grenoble. The program aims to foster cross‑disciplinary exchange among fields such as computer vision, speech processing, affective computing, and human‑robot interaction, while providing opportunities for outdoor activities and collaboration.

name: Northern Lights Deep Learning Winter School
venue: UiT The Arctic University of Norway, Tromsø, Norway
description: The 2027 Winter School is part of the Northern Lights Deep Learning Conference and will be held in Tromsø, Norway. It runs from 11 to 15 January and focuses on deep learning advances such as image classification, object detection, segmentation, time‑series prediction and speech recognition. The school targets researchers and practitioners who want to exchange ideas, collaborate and learn about state‑of‑the‑art methods.

name: Annual Nepal AI School (ANAIS)
venue: Kathmandu World School, Suryabinayanak, Kathmandu, Nepal
description: The 7th Annual Nepal AI School (ANAIS) is an 11‑day intensive in‑person program held at Kathmandu World School in Kathmandu, Nepal. It offers lectures, labs, and project work covering fundamentals to advanced topics such as geometric deep learning, generative modeling, neuro‑symbolic AI, and more, aimed at senior undergraduates, graduate students, PhD candidates, faculty, and industry professionals. The school seeks to build AI expertise in the region, foster collaboration among international researchers, and inspire early‑stage researchers from Nepal and neighboring countries.

name: EEML Summer School
description: The Eastern European Machine Learning Summer School takes place in Cetinje, Montenegro from 27 July to 1 August 2026. It offers lectures and tutorials on machine learning by leading researchers from academia and industry, covering topics such as deep learning, generative models, and AI applications. The program includes a diverse set of speakers from institutions like Google DeepMind, MIT, and the University of Cambridge, providing participants with cutting‑edge knowledge and networking opportunities.

name: Mediterranean Summer School
venue: Mediterranean Machine Learning Summer School, Barcelona, Spain
description: The Mediterranean Machine Learning (M2L) Summer School is a five‑day program in Barcelona, Spain, offering keynotes, lectures, and practical sessions led by AI experts. It targets doctoral and outstanding master students, academics and practitioners, focusing on topics such as computer vision, natural language processing, generative models, reinforcement learning, and ethics in machine learning. The school emphasizes diversity, networking, and collaboration through poster sessions, scholarships, and social activities.

name: AthNLP Summer School 2026
description: The Athens Natural Language Processing Summer School 2026 (AthNLP) is a week‑long program held at the NCSR Demokritos campus in Athens, Greece. It brings together experts from institutions such as RC Athena, NCSR Demokritos, Athens University of Economics and Business, Heriot‑Watt University and ELLIS‑University of Manchester to cover recent advances in NLP. The school targets graduate students and researchers who want hands‑on experience and networking opportunities in modern language‑technology methods.

name: Advanced Artificial Intelligence: GenAI & Deep Unsupervised Learning
venue: Lady Margaret Hall, Oxford, United Kingdom
description: The AI For Finance summer school is offered by Lady Margaret Hall, Oxford as part of the LMH Oxford Summer Programmes. It focuses on artificial intelligence and machine learning techniques applied to financial problems, covering topics such as robust ML, continual learning, and malicious user detection. The residential (or online) session runs from 28 June to 16 July 2027 and is aimed at students and professionals interested in AI-driven finance.

name: LUT Summer School
description: LUT Summer School is a one‑week academic event offering intensive courses in sustainability, climate action, marketing, management, and the intersection of business and technology. The programme combines online learning with an on‑campus week at LUT University’s Lappeenranta campus in August 2027, targeting bachelor’s and master’s students who are enrolled at a higher‑education institution. Participants benefit from workshops, group work, social activities in Finnish nature, and the opportunity to earn 3 ECTS credits while experiencing Finland’s summer.

name: 1st Internationa School on the Cognitive, Ethical, and Societal Dimensions of AI - AIces
description: AIces 2026 is the first international school focusing on the cognitive, ethical and societal dimensions of artificial intelligence, targeting graduate and postgraduate students as well as industry practitioners. The programme offers parallel courses, a symposium, and open debates, with both face‑to‑face interaction in Porto and live online participation, and recordings available for 45 days after the event. The school takes place in Porto, Portugal from 30 March to 2 April 2026.

name: Summer School on Multimodal Foundation Models and Generative AI
venue: Institut National des Postes et Télécommunications, Rabat, Morocco
description: The 2nd edition of the AI Summer School on Multimodal Foundation Models and Generative AI is a five‑day immersive program jointly organized by MoroccoAI, INPT, IMT Nord Europe, and Soft Centre. It targets master and Ph.D. students, post‑docs, young and senior researchers, and industry professionals, offering expert lectures, hands‑on labs, and networking opportunities to develop cutting‑edge AI skills. The school takes place at the Institut National des Postes et Télécommunications in Rabat, Morocco, and emphasizes both theoretical foundations and practical implementation of advanced AI models.

name: AI4Science Summer School
description: The 2nd Summer School on Advancing Scientific Discovery with AI takes place in Caen, Normandy, France in 2025. It focuses on applying AI techniques such as machine learning, generative models, and AI‑driven experimental design to accelerate scientific research across various domains, with hands‑on workshops using Python libraries like NumPy and PyTorch. The programme is aimed at PhD students, post‑doctoral researchers and scientists familiar with mathematical modelling and numerical computation, offering interdisciplinary collaboration and skill development.
